Nordson Sonoscan
GEN7™ C‑SAM® Acoustic Microscope
Project Description:
Medical & Laboratory
Design Team: Cesaroni Design & Nordson Sonoscan
The design created by Cesaroni Design for the Gen 7 Acoustic 
Micro Imaging instrument for Nordson SONOSCAN is optimized for user efficiency. 
Dual twenty-eight inch 4K monitors are strategically placed near testing bay to 
allow a user to monitor test results and their test subject. The machined, 
stainless steel work surface has been incorporated into the Gen 7 and has been ergonomically 
contoured to allow user access without sacrificing usable table space. The fabricated 
sheet metal body of the Gen 7 maximizes the unit’s durability and access for 
servicing.
